items.title: Approximate counting requires a large untrusted quantum witness or quadratically many membership queries
items.author: Scott Aaronson; Robin Kothari; William Kretschmer; Justin Thaler
items.source_version: Official complete47-page CCC2020 CC BY3.0 Unported publication; mainTheorem2 and complete Section3 QMA lower-bound mechanism with full Section2 prerequisites. Nonexclusive nativev3 private only.
items.difficulty_reason: The authors restrict a symmetric bivariate polynomial to a hyperbola to obtain a Laurent polynomial, control its growth across an L-shaped region, and exploit the nonnegligible acceptance probability and large gap produced by guessing a QMA witness to separate witness length from query cost.
